dedupe_keys.name: rcm dx rail condition monitoring data exchange format sbb openrail association

description: RCM-DX is a data exchange format for rail condition monitoring, optimised for data points localised within a railway network. The README explains that railways continuously gather data on rail, overhead line and telecommunications networks with mobile and stationary measuring systems, and that RCM-DX gives a uniform way to store, process and exchange these measurements. It is a file format detailing HDF5, chosen as an open hierarchical format. SBB developed it and published it as an open-source standard in 2022, then donated it to the OpenRail Association for independent stewardship; SBB is working on open tools to read, write and display files. Coverage: any railway measurement system. Format and access: specification in Markdown and PDF. Licence and cost: Eclipse Public License 2.0, free. Caveats: a format, not data; extensions may break compatibility, as the README warns. It supports digital twin and resilience work on track and catenary condition. It relates to RailSystemModel and RINF in the catalogue.
